description:
About these variants

Four precision levels are available for Qwen-Image-2.1, trading VRAM and speed against generation quality:

- BF16 — full-precision reference (~14 GB). Highest quality, largest footprint.
- INT8 (W8A8) — 8-bit weights + 8-bit activations (~7 GB). Near-lossless quality, ~2× smaller than BF16, runs on INT8 tensor cores (RTX 30-series and up).
- INT6 (W6A8) — 6-bit weights + 8-bit activations (~5.5 GB). Middle-ground: smaller than INT8 with only a small quality trade-off.
- INT4 (W4A8) — 4-bit weights + 8-bit activations (~4 GB). Smallest footprint; uses ConvRot with a per-tensor codebook that decodes to INT8 for compute, so it runs on the same INT8 hardware as W8A8. Larger quality trade-off than INT6.
